name: Disease Carrier
body:
True to insects which your forebears resemble, you’re now a carrier of a deadly disease.

Prerequisite(s): Sanguinai, Bloodsucker, Con 15

Benefit(s): You become immune to malaria, but your saliva carries this deadly disease. People bitten or drained of blood by you risk infection and have to save against the disease. Its save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 of your Hit Dice + your Constitution modifier.

Type disease, injury; save Fortitude; onset 1d3 days; frequency 1/day; effect 1d3 Str damage and 1d3 Con damage and target is fatigued; cure 2 consecutive saves.
